summary: Rider app + rider backend tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (auth, role isolation, all accept guards incl. PLACED/offline/409 race/busy, pickup/deliver guards, 403 for other rider, reject before/after pickup, partner assign-rider -> 'assigned', live GPS over customer WS {type:'location', rider, eta_mins, status}, no auto progression (READY held 22s), customer cancel / partner reject freeing the rider). Frontend (375x667, geolocation granted): login + login-error, home (Hi Ravi, online-card/toggle/status, offline-card, 4 stats), going online, 'GPS locked', location-banner shown only when permission is missing, requests that arrive live over WS when the partner accepts, accept -> active card -> delivery screen (Leaflet/OSM iframe with attribution and 3 .pin markers, pickup disabled 'Waiting for restaurant to mark ready…'), live status PREPARING -> 'Ready for pickup' -> pickup enabled -> Drop-off/'Navigate to customer' -> deliver toast -> Home earnings +₹55, Earnings tab row '+₹55 Payout pending', decline flow (toast, order back in pool), profile + logout. All of these work. I found and fixed one CRITICAL bug: the rider WebSocket kept reconnecting in an endless loop. No 500s in the backend logs. No deprecated Expo packages and no SafeAreaView issues detected.

minor.issue: Returns 409 'This delivery was already taken' for orders that do not exist, or that are DELIVERED or CANCELLED. It should return 404, or 400 'no longer available'.
Race condition: the 'Finish your current delivery first' check happens separately from the atomic order claim. Two accepts sent at the same time by one rider for different orders could both succeed.
Does not require the rider to be online. The rider snapshot uses the restaurant's lat/lng instead of the rider's last known lat/lng.
Loads up to 5000 DELIVERED orders and filters 'today' in Python. Use a Mongo query or aggregation on delivered_at instead.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY T1: the WS effect depended on the whole `rider` object. refresh() calls setRider(), which creates a new object, so the effect re-ran, closed and reopened the socket, and onopen called refresh() again. Result: an endless loop of about 11 WS reconnects and 11 /rider/dashboard calls every 15s, and WS messages could be lost. Changed the dependency to riderId. Re-test: 0 reconnects in 10s.

router.replace('/home') from the stacked /delivery route leaves a second hidden (tabs) instance: 2 home-screen nodes were found in the DOM after delivering. Use router.dismissTo('/home') or router.back() instead.

integration_issues.issue: Location is only POSTed when watchPositionAsync fires (distanceInterval 10m). A stationary rider sent 0 POSTs in 15s and only 1 in a whole session, so the customer gets no location or ETA updates until the rider moves. When moving, 3 POSTs were sent and the customer order showed the updated rider.lat/lng. Suggest re-sending the last position every 10-15s, and right after accept/pickup.
Requests that arrive via WS 'request_new' have no distance_km, so 'x km away' is missing until refresh. stat-requests (pending_requests) also does not update live from WS events.

issues: 'Decline this delivery' acts on one tap with no confirmation, so it is easy to tap by mistake.

action_items: Keep the T1 fix in src/context/rider.tsx (WS effect depends on riderId, not the rider object). Apply the same pattern anywhere else an effect depends on `rider`.
Add a GPS heartbeat: re-POST the last position every 10-15s while online and immediately after accept/pickup, so the customer gets location and ETA even when the rider is stationary.
Return 404 or 400 instead of 409 'already taken' when accepting an order that does not exist or is DELIVERED/CANCELLED.
Use router.dismissTo('/home') or router.back() after deliver/reject instead of router.replace('/home').
Add distance_km and earning to WS request_new payloads (or compute them client-side). Refresh stat-requests on WS events.
Optional: add a confirm dialog for decline. assign-rider should use the rider's real location and require the rider to be online.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 746 lines (>700). Split it into modules (orders, payments, auth).
Stale comments: server.py (~line 697) and core.py's docstring still mention simulate_delivery / 'delivery simulation', but simulation was removed.
pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope. The stateful rider suite must run with -n 0, otherwise one class's module teardown sets the riders offline while the other class is mid-run.
Creating files under /app/backend triggers a uvicorn --reload and brief 502s. Put helper scripts outside the backend dir.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; WS reconnect loop fixed; GPS heartbeat missing)

Tab screens stay mounted, so append '>> visible=true' to testID selectors.
rca_of_issue: WS reconnect loop: rider.tsx useEffect([rider, refresh]) -> ws.onopen -> refresh() -> setRider({online,status}) -> new rider object reference -> effect cleanup closes the WS -> reconnect -> onopen -> refresh ... Mitigation: depend on rider?.id.
